answer: Think of each new agent key as a marble block hauled up to a mesa: it earns nothing until it has stood there for, say, 30 epochs (a design assumption), answering fresh challenges that peers grade. That seasoning is sequential wall-clock time bound to one key's own history, so a clone farm can't split it; every fake must climb the mesa separately and pay its own hourly work. One sable mark from a duplicate-text catch freezes that key's bond and restarts its climb, so cost scales per clone, never shared.
